name: Todd Blanche
description: Follow Todd Blanche, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: GOP senators clear Todd Blanche’s AG path after ‘anti-weaponization’ fund scrapped
changes.summary: Blanche’s nomination had been held up over concerns from GOP Sens. John Cornyn and Thom Tillis, but the parties reached a deal to end the standoff.

changes.title: Sen. Alex Padilla, D-Calif., on expected vote to advance Todd Blanche's nomination
changes.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Sen. Alex Padilla, D-Calif., about the Senate Judiciary Committee's anticipated vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general.

changes.title: Senate Judiciary Committee to vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general
changes.summary: The Senate Judiciary Committee is expected to vote Tuesday on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general after Blanche assuaged concerns from two Republican senators.

changes.title: Todd Blanche Wins Over G.O.P. Holdouts on AG Confirmation After Assurances on Trump IRS Deal
changes.summary: Senators John Cornyn and Thom Tillis expressed support after Todd Blanche, the acting attorney general, issued a memo abandoning part of a deal the Justice Department had struck with President Trump.

changes.title: Republicans Let Trump Keep Unparalleled Benefit: I.R.S. Immunity
changes.summary: The rebellion against Todd Blanche’s nomination to be attorney general, now seemingly contained, at no point fundamentally questioned President Trump’s new protections from the I.R.S.

changes.title: Cornyn, Tillis back Blanche for attorney general after deal on DOJ fund
changes.summary: GOP Sens. John Cornyn of Texas and Thom Tillis of North Carolina formally announced their support on Monday for Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general.

changes.title: Todd Blanche's nomination back on track after GOP deal
changes.summary: Todd Blanche's attorney general nomination is moving forward after two Republican senators received written assurances the Justice Department would abandon a controversial compensation fund.

changes.title: Blanche wins support from GOP holdouts after vowing to scrap 'anti-weaponization fund'
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche cleared a major hurdle in his push to permanently lead the Department of Justice. He reached a deal with two GOP senators who had said they would block his nomination. Blanche put into writing that the DOJ is scrapping a $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization" fund that could have provide.

changes.title: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche issues order rescinding "anti-weaponization" fund
changes.summary: The order came after Republican Senators Thom Tillis and John Cornyn threatened to block Blanche's confirmation for Attorney General if the fund was not rescinded in writing.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche has issued a formal order terminating President Donald Trump's $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization fund" to compensate his political allies.
